title: 第9章 拯救成功之后的奖励第10章 狮鹫骑士团
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
;;
窗外的雀鸟叫得让人心烦。
这会儿，房间里倒是安静了。
那种淡淡的百合香气已经淡去。
隐约能听到楼下厨房传来切菜的笃笃声，还有锅碗瓢盆碰撞的动静。
贤惠的凯瑟琳oo，大概正哼着歌，准备给肖恩做一顿早餐。
肖恩哼唧了一声，不想动。
这种早晨太舒服了，被窝里还残留着好闻的余温，让人只想赖到地老天荒。
他下意识地翻了个身，想找个舒服的姿势，胸口却感到一阵沉甸甸的压迫感。
软绵绵的，触感极佳。
他费劲地睁开一条眼缝。
西尔维娅。
她早就醒了。
此时她正单手支着脑袋，侧躺在他身边，那一头金发乱糟糟地披散着，反而更添了几分慵懒的媚态。
“醒了？”
她的声音带着一种还没睡醒的鼻音。
肖恩喉结动了动，没说话。
“凯瑟琳去楼下了。”西尔维娅慢条斯理地说着，眼神却往楼下飘了一下。
肖恩：“你想干什么？”
西尔维娅笑了一声。

“很辛苦吧？”
还没等肖恩想明白这句话里的深意，眼前那个熟悉的淡蓝色面板毫无征兆地跳了出来。
【角色：西尔维娅·德莱厄斯】
【当前拯救进度：100％】
红色的数字鲜艳得刺眼。
肖恩愣住了。
这就满了？
这女人的拯救难度是不是有问题，还是说她脑子里的那根弦早就搭好了，就等着这一刻？
一种不妙的预感顺着脊梁骨往上窜。
“你在发什么呆？”
西尔维娅只看到肖恩在盯着虚空出神。
她不喜欢被忽视。
下一秒。
还没等肖恩反应过来。
“既然凯瑟琳不在……”
content_en:
;;
The birds chirping outside the window are disturbing.
At this moment, the room was quiet.
The faint lily scent has faded.
The sound of chopping vegetables and the clinking of pots and pans could be heard vaguely from the kitchen downstairs.
The virtuous Catherine, probably humming a song, is preparing to make breakfast for Sean.
Sean grunted and didn't want to move.
This kind of morning is so comfortable, and the good-smelling warmth still lingers in the bed, making people just want to stay there until the end of the world.
He turned over subconsciously, trying to find a comfortable position, but felt a heavy pressure on his chest.
Soft and feels great to the touch.
He struggled to open his eyes.
Sylvia.
She had already woken up.
At this time, she was supporting her head with one hand, lying on her side next to him, and her blond hair was messy, which only added to her lazy and charming look.
"Are you awake?"
Her voice had a nasal sound that had not yet woken up.
Sean's Adam's apple moved but he said nothing.
"Catherine is going downstairs." Sylvia said slowly, but her eyes drifted downstairs.
Sean: "What do you want to do?"
Sylvia laughed.
"Is it hard?"
Before Sean could understand the deeper meaning of this sentence, the familiar light blue panel jumped out in front of him without any warning.
[Character: Sylvia Darius]
[Current rescue progress: 100%]
The red numbers are dazzlingly bright.
Sean was stunned.
Is this full?
Is there a problem with the difficulty of rescuing this woman, or is it that the string in her mind has been set up a long time ago and she is just waiting for this moment?
A bad premonition ran up his spine.
"What are you thinking about?"
Sylvia only saw Sean staring into the void.
She doesn't like to be ignored.
The next second.
Before Sean could react.
"Since Catherine is not here..."
